content.text:
Deploy apps and services to the cloud in seconds

  USAGE

    ink [command] [--flags]

  COMMANDS

    login [--flags]                 Authenticate with Ink via browser OAuth or API key
    whoami                          Show account info, plan, usage, and GitHub connection status
    deploy <name> [--flags]         Deploy a service for the first time
    service [name] [--flags]        List all deployed services or show details for one
    repo [command]                  Create repos and get git remotes for pushing code
    status <name> [--flags]         Get service details with optional logs and CPU/memory/network metrics
    metrics <name> [--flags]        View CPU/memory/network metrics for a service
    redeploy <name> [--flags]       Rebuild and redeploy a service, optionally updating its config
    workspace [command]             Create and manage team workspaces, members, and invites
    exec <service> -- <command...>  Run a command in a running service container
    logs <name> [--flags]           View build or runtime logs for a service
    secret [command]                Set, list, and remove environment variables and secrets on a service
    delete <name> [--flags]         Permanently delete a service and its deployment
    domain [command]                Attach or remove custom domains from services
    dns [command]                   Manage DNS zones and records for delegated domains
    project [command]               List and manage projects. Services are grouped into projects.
    template [command] [search]     Deploy pre-configured stacks with a single command
    config [command]                Set default workspace and project so you don't need --workspace and --project on every command
    update                          Check for updates and show how to upgrade
    chat [command]                  Send and read messages in workspace or project channels
    help [command]                  Help about any command

  FLAGS

    --api-key                       Api key (overrides config)
    --api-url                       Graphql API URL (overrides config)
    -h --help                       Help for ink
    --json                          Output as JSON
    --oauth-url                     Oauth server URL (overrides config)
    --project                       Project slug (overrides config)
    -v --version                    Version for ink
